scripts.copy:once: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; : ${VAULT_PATH:?Set VAULT_PATH to your vault path}; plugin=obsidian-listen-mode; DEST="$VAULT_PATH/.obsidian/plugins/$plugin"; mkdir -p "$DEST"; rsync -a --delete --include "manifest.json" --include "main.js" --include "styles.css" --exclude "*" ./ "$DEST/"; echo Copied to "$DEST"'
scripts.deploy: bun run build && bun run copy:once
